propositions: GitHub Actions run logs and metadata contain coverage percentages and CI-health signals (status, duration, red-to-green recovery) but are retained for only a short window, requiring harvesting into a durable store

A new isolated adapter must parse coverage from the pytest-cov TOTAL line in GHA run-log tail and compute CI-health metrics (failure-to-pass recovery interval, recheck/flake rate) from run-metadata JSON without modifying the CI workflow

The harvester script must read GHA run history via the API, extract metrics through the adapter, and persist them as labeled snapshots to the tracked .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson file (not reports/)
The GHA adapter and harvester must remain isolated from core command modules so that the core never imports or depends on GitHub Actions-specific logic, enabling future adapters for other CI systems

The persistence path and portability guard must be validated via unit tests that verify correct snapshot store location, parsing accuracy (e.g. 84.2% coverage from fixture logs), and absence of adapter imports in core metrics modules
